name: Ninh Binh station
summary: North–South stop in the city: SE7 from Hà Nội arrives at 08:16. The ride is about two hours, and the timetable places the station at kilometre 115 from Hà Nội. The door is on đường Ngô Gia Tự, phường Hoa Lư, between Cát Đằng and Cầu Yên. SE1 arrives at 00:03 the next day. SE5, SE9, and SE3 also stop southbound. SE10 does not.
dotReason: How you arrive, not why you stay
getThere: Đường Ngô Gia Tự, phường Hoa Lư, between Cát Đằng and Cầu Yên.
heroCaption: The station front and the sign GA NINH BÌNH

notice.title: The last southbound arrival is after midnight
notice.body: SE1 leaves Hà Nội at 21:45 and reaches Ninh Bình at 00:03 the next day. SE10 has no stop here.

body: Southbound, the zero is Hà Nội and Ninh Bình is kilometre 115. The opened cells are SE7 06:00–08:16 (2 hours 16 minutes), SE5 08:00–10:16 (2 hours 16 minutes), SE9 13:00–15:17 (2 hours 17 minutes), SE3 19:20–21:36 (2 hours 16 minutes), and SE1 21:45–00:03 the next day (2 hours 18 minutes). Northbound, the other table zeros at Sài Gòn. Ninh Bình is kilometre 1611 and Hà Nội is 1726, and 1726 minus 1611 is 115 again.

Northbound, SE8 takes 2 hours 21 minutes, SE6 takes 2 hours 19 minutes, SE4 takes 2 hours 22 minutes, and SE2 takes 2 hours 18 minutes. SE10 has no Ninh Bình cell. The address is đường Ngô Gia Tự, phường Hoa Lư, between ga Cát Đằng and ga Cầu Yên. The hero is the newer front, sign GA NINH BÌNH. The second frame is an older yellow front with the same words.

figures.caption: An older station front, still signed GA NINH BÌNH
figures.alt: A yellow station building with the sign GA NINH BÌNH

gettingThere: The station is the city stop on the North–South line, đường Ngô Gia Tự, phường Hoa Lư. From Hà Nội the southbound cells that stop are SE7, SE5, SE9, SE3, and SE1.

legs.heading: From Hanoi station
legs.body: SE7 leaves at 06:00 and reaches Ninh Bình at 08:16. Later southbound cells are SE5, SE9, SE3, and SE1. SE10 has no stop here.

legs.heading: Back to Hanoi
legs.body: SE8, SE6, SE4, and SE2 stop. The cell gaps are 2 hours 21 minutes, 2 hours 19 minutes, 2 hours 22 minutes, and 2 hours 18 minutes. The day offsets on the northbound table are counted from a Sài Gòn departure.

admissionNote: Rail fares and any platform fee sit with the railway on the day.
